name: comp-290
title: Error Notification Card
blurb: Error card with title, description, action button, and dismiss.
description: Static error notification card with red alert icon, bold title, descriptive text, action button, and dismissible close. Larger vertical card layout.
use_when: You need to display an error that requires attention with explanatory text and a clear action path.
avoid_when: For quick, dismissible error messages or simple alerts; use smaller banner alerts instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
